items.label: Gentle Guidance for Your Feline Friend
items.value: Watching your favorite sofa and carpet turn into a scratching post? We understand. That’s why we created a smarter way to communicate with your cat. Think of cat scratch deterrent spray as an invisible ‘training signal’ to help you gently steer your cat toward more appropriate behaviors. Save your decor, strengthen your bond with your pet, and enjoy peace of mind, all with a simple

items.label: A More Friendly to Communicate
items.value: Our spray formula works by delivering two ‘training signals’ that cats instinctively understand. First, a fresh botanical scent creates a clear olfactory boundary, deter marking or scratching; second, a safe, naturally-derived taste provides a mild reminder for curious chewers. Together, they provide consistent, gentle feedback that helps your cat learn boundaries effortlessly and effectively

items.label: Build Lasting Habits with Consistent Use
items.value: A clear ‘training signal’ is powerful, but consistency makes it stick. For optimal results, Cat Deterrent Spray 1–2 times daily on target areas (like sofa corners or curtains) during the initial training period. This routine reinforces the natural cues, helping your cat learn household boundaries and providing gentle reminders even when you’re not home

items.label: Pet-Safe Formula
items.value: Gentle protection, trusted by pet families. Following our principle of gentle guidance, our cat scratch deterrent spray is crafted with a blend of naturally derived essential oils, including Peppermint and Lemongrass, used at minimal, pet-safe concentrations. So you can breathe easy, knowing you're guiding your cat with care, never with harm

items.label: Indoor or Outdoor Use
items.value: Your go-to solution for a peaceful home. Use it indoors to help protect furniture, curtains, and Christmas trees. Use it outdoors to create a gentle boundary for patios or gardens. Jilca cat deterrent spray is specifically designed to address various feline behaviors such as scratching, chewing, spraying and peeing, fostering harmony between you and your pet in nearly every situation

items.label: Item Package Dimensions L X W X H
Directions
items.value: For best results, reapply once daily or as needed during early training to help reduce unwanted behaviors. Reward your cat with praise when you see good behavior. DO NOT SPRAY DIRECTLY ON PETS. To further support training, trim your cat’s nails regularly and provide a scratching post as an appropriate alternative.
